issuer: the Parish (each of Jersey's parishes issues its residents' licences)
note: Read 2026-11-03. The Government of Jersey's pages (which had answered a firewall block on 2026-10-30 and 10-31): category B (car or light van) from 17; to get a full licence a learner holds a provisional licence (£30, six months), passes the theory and then the practical test; no minimum time on the provisional licence is set for a car (one is set only for a heavy motorcycle, 12 months on a full A1), so the full licence is held from 17. The parish may decline to renew a provisional licence if its holder hasn't tried the tests within six months, not held. The Motor Vehicles (Driving Licences) (Jersey) Order 2003, read the same day, leaves the ages to Article 20(4) of the Road Traffic (Jersey) Law 1956. The parishes' pages (St Brelade's and St Helier's, and the parishes' online service, parish.je, read 2026-10-30, 10-31 and 11-03): the Parish issues the licence, £70 for ten years from 1 January 2024; some categories expire at 66 and are renewed yearly after, not held. No identity card and no exchange list were read.

sources.title: Driving licence categories, Government of Jersey
sources.said: There is a different minimum age for each category. ... B (car or light van) maximum authorized mass of 3,500kg maximum 9 seats not included in any other category can tow a trailer with a maximum authorized mass of 750kg 17

sources.title: Driving tests and learning to drive, Government of Jersey
sources.said: To get your full driving licence to drive a vehicle or ride a moped or motorcycle you need to: check what age you can drive get a provisional licence pass your driving theory test ... practice and take driving lessons pass your practical driving test ... Car or light goods vehicle (van less than 3,500kg) B 17 ... A provisional licence costs £30 and is valid for 6 months.

sources.title: Jersey Driving Licence, Parish of St Brelade
sources.said: have attained the appropriate age for the vehicle category ... pay £70 for a 10-year driving licence or £30 for a provisional licence ... A driving licence is valid for ten years and costs £70 (from 1/1/2024).

sources.title: Renew your Jersey driving licence, Driving Licence Online (the parishes of Jersey, parish.je)
sources.said: A fee of £70 is payable for a full licence, or £30 to renew a provisional.
